title: 🎓 New Assignment: Create Your Own AI Workflow
message:
Hello Students,

Your next assignment for the AI Productivity Masterclass is now live!
In this task, you’ll design and document your own AI-powered workflow using tools like ChatGPT, Notion AI, or Canva Magic Studio.

🔹 Objective: Show how AI can save time or improve productivity in your daily routine.
🔹 Deadline: December 10, 2025 – 11:59 PM (EAT)
🔹 Submission Format: PDF, DOCX, or short screen recording (max 3 minutes)

Make sure to review the full instructions in your Assignments Tab before submitting.

If you have any questions, message your instructor via the Messages Tab or open a ticket under Support.

Keep up the great work — let’s see what AI can do when creativity meets strategy!

title: 📢 5:00 AM Challenge — Important Update
message: Thank you for showing up and committing to the challenge. We have reviewed the issues some participants experienced and here are the updates.
content:
📢 5:00 AM Challenge — Important Update

Good morning everyone,

Thank you for showing up and committing to the challenge. We have reviewed the issues some participants experienced and here are the updates:

1️⃣ Session Time Update
The daily access window has been extended to give everyone more flexibility.
New access time is 5:00 AM to 8:30 AM

2️⃣ Quiz and Assessment Status
If your quiz shows as not completed even after finishing it, or if a retake is not opening, this is being corrected manually.
No participant will be penalized for system related issues.

3️⃣ Logged Out Mid Quiz
If you were logged out while taking a quiz, simply log back in and continue.
Your progress is being restored where interruptions occurred.

4️⃣ Login Challenges
Early morning internet can be unstable. For a smoother experience:
• Use one device per session
• Avoid switching networks during quizzes
• If Wi Fi is unstable, try mobile data

Important note:
What matters is your effort and completion, not technical interruptions.
All affected cases are being reviewed and resolved.

Thank you for your patience and discipline.
Let us keep going strong.

—
Elvis
Click2Skill
5:00 AM Challenge

title: HOW TO ACCESS THE AI PRODUCTIVITY COHORT DASHBOARD (CLICK2SKILL)
message:
Please follow the steps below carefully to avoid access or progress issues.

1️⃣ Click the access link below
https://click2skill.com/cohort-access?token=O0Vz0FoPQIwYWD2mH6XYqhZUff2nluor

2️⃣ Click “Log in to enroll”
New users: Create an account
Existing users: Log in
Faster option: Continue with Google

3️⃣ Click “Enroll Now”
You will be taken directly to the cohort dashboard

4️⃣ This is where the cohort engine runs

Lesson unlock timer
Daily access window
Progress tracking

5️⃣ You can also access your main dashboard here
https://click2skill.com/dashboard/

6️⃣ Inside the dashboard, click “Cohorts”
https://click2skill.com/dashboard/cohorts
View active and upcoming cohorts
See cohorts you are already enrolled in

7️⃣ When the lesson unlocks, click “Start Learning”
Access the lesson for the day

8️⃣ IMPORTANT – DO NOT SKIP THIS STEP

After finishing the lesson, click “Complete Lesson”
This automatically loads the daily quiz modal
Your progress is only recorded after this step

If you experience any issues:
Use the “Need Support” option on the platform
Or share screenshots or a short video in the WhatsApp group
Please follow these steps exactly to avoid access issues.
